stops.name: Hulløya
stops.detail: Hulløya between Kjøpsviksund and Hulløysund is the largest island in Tysfjord with an area of 22 km².

stops.name: Litl-Hulløya
stops.detail: Southwest of it lies the significantly smaller island Litl-Hulløya (approx. 0.8 km²).

stops.name: Lifjell
stops.detail: Kjøpsvik is located at Kjøpsnes squeezed between the fjord and the 849 m high Lifjell.

stops.name: Musken
stops.detail: Musken, in the middle of Hellmofjord, is considered the only place with a purely Lule Sámi population in Norway.

stops.name: Hellmobotn
stops.detail: Hellmobotn is a popular starting point for cross-country skiers, with marked trails that lead to Sweden, among other places.
